body.purpose: Shared interface and marketing copy; canonical wordmark remains outlined artwork.

motion.name: vendor-feedback
motion.purpose: Use the native component transition and respect reduced motion.

narrative.northStar: A quiet place for shared work.
narrative.overview: Black, white and gray establish the interface hierarchy. Mint, lilac, peach and mustard identify content while semantic states retain their separate roles. Canonical artwork and Google Sans unite the surfaces.
keyCharacteristics: Canonical ink or inverse white artwork with a coral core
HeroUI default geometry and compound APIs

rules.name: Neutral Foundation
rules.body: Keep component surfaces and ordinary controls neutral.

rules.name: Category Accent
rules.body: Use optional tinted category accents with explicit labels and stable assignments.

rules.name: Artwork
rules.body: Preserve the canonical symbol, coral core and original outlined wordmark.

dos: Use the shared runtime tokens and component exports.
Pair every colored surface with a readable foreground.
donts: Do not generate another runtime token catalog.
Do not recreate the root .impeccable folder.
Do not use category colors as semantic status substitutes.
